Class LobbyController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.controller.lobby.LobbyController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class LobbyController extends Object implements Runnable
Controller responsible for managing a single active Lobby instance and processing all network/system commands relating to it.

Threading & Design:

  • Implements Runnable and executes inside its own dedicated worker thread (named Lobby-ID-Worker).
  • Uses a thread-safe command queue (BlockingQueue) to receive commands asynchronously.
  • The run loop processes enqueued commands sequentially (FIFO), preventing concurrency conflicts and race conditions on the underlying Lobby model without lock overhead.

Lobby to Game Transition Flow: When the host triggers the match start:

  1. Validates state via Lobby.startMatch(String).
  2. Builds player instances using LobbyPlayerFactory (assigning totem colors and shuffling order).
  3. Instantiates a Game and a corresponding GameController.
  4. Moves connected sessions in ServerSessionRegistry from Lobby phase to Game phase.
  5. Migrates listeners from the Lobby observer list to the Game observer list.
  6. Unregisters itself from the registry and terminates its own run loop.
  7. Spins up a new Game-ID-Worker thread for the game.
  8. Spins up a temporary countdown thread to trigger match setup.
